description: Java source code for MediaDrmBridge class, a wrapper around Android's MediaDrm API, managing DRM sessions, provisioning, and media crypto creation.

classes.name: UpdateSessionResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of updating a DRM session, indicating success or failure and an error message if applicable.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a MediaDrmBridge instance with Widevine scheme if supported.

methods.name: isWidevineCryptoSchemeSupported
methods.description: Checks if Widevine DRM scheme is supported.

methods.name: isCbcsSchemeSupported
methods.description: Checks if CBCS encryption scheme is supported (API 26+).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Releases resources and destroys the MediaDrmBridge instance.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with initialization data and MIME type.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Provides a response to update an existing DRM session.

methods.name: getMetricsInBase64
methods.description: Retrieves DRM metrics encoded in Base64 (API 28+).

methods.name: getMediaCrypto
methods.description: Returns the MediaCrypto object associated with this instance.
